_comment: Provenance for the character master artwork.
The masters are 80-210 MB each (~1.3 GB total) and are deliberately NOT in the
repository: `assets/sources/characters/*.png` is gitignored. This manifest is
what makes them recoverable without archaeology through git history — re-fetch
by driveId, check the sha256, then run scripts/import-character-assets.py.
`employee` is the authoritative link. Asset files are never matched to animals
by filename: every entry names the employee id from src/content/employees.ts and
the species recorded in src/art/critterShapes.ts, and a test asserts the two
agree so a cat can never end up wearing the owl's artwork.
`officeHeight` is the authored CSS height for that animal in the office diorama
BEFORE the global presence multiplier in src/content/characterScale.ts. The
importer encodes @1x at exactly this height so it maps 1:1 to CSS pixels.

fetch.note: Large files may be throttled; retry until the payload starts with the PNG signature and ends with IEND.

characters.skipReason: The shipped pip.png is the REPAIRED build. This master still carries the alpha defect that made the halo shimmer (measured peak-to-peak 16.95 vs 2.10 for the repaired asset), so re-importing it would reintroduce a bug that was fixed and verified on real hardware. Kept here as the master of record only.
